transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started with our weekly project huddle. I understand we have a twelve-bed teaching garden planned beside the science wing, with the volunteer workday currently proposed for October 18 and an estimated $3,000 charge to general funds. Before I can sign off on this campus project plan, I need each of you to report on the requirements you've verified in your respective areas. Let's start with you — what have you confirmed regarding site suitability, purchasing, and student safety?

transcript.text: I need to report a site safety issue. I just received soil test results yesterday from the proposed garden area, and they measured lead at 180 parts per million. Our district garden standard requires removing the top six inches of soil and using raised beds at that reading. This means the current draft plan's use of in-ground beds does not meet the district standard, and we'll need to revise the plan to use raised beds instead. I have not yet entered this result in the project folder, but I'm flagging it now before any approval is given.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a site logistics issue. My utility-locate request just cleared this morning, and it only authorizes work on October 28 — not before that date. The draft plan's proposed workday of October 18 cannot proceed because facilities policy requires a posted site permit before any excavation or bed assembly can begin. This means the workday needs to be moved to October 28 at the earliest, and the site permit will need to be posted at the garden location before work starts.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report a funding issue. I received the community-garden grant award confirmation yesterday, and it specifies an approved project budget of exactly $4,200 — higher than the current draft's $3,000 estimate. The grant will reimburse up to that $4,200 amount, but only for purchases covered by a purchase order issued before ordering. I have not yet attached the award confirmation to the draft budget, so the funding source on the campus project form currently lists general funds rather than the grant.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to report a student safety issue. My student health review, completed this week, identified a documented severe latex allergy among the students scheduled for garden instruction. Under our school safety protocol, this requires nitrile-only gloves instead of the standard latex gardening gloves currently listed in the draft plan, and an allergy-safety notice must be posted at the garden entrance. The review was completed after the draft equipment list was prepared, so the current plan's listing of latex gloves does not meet the safety requirement.
